title: RelationDef
description: K'UHUL semantic relation declaration. @kind must be semantic.relation.v1. Defines a typed, named predicate for use in fact assertions. IMPORTANT: Relation schema authority (@authority) applies to this schema declaration only — it does NOT grant authority to facts that use this relation. A verified 'CAUSES' relation definition does not make every asserted causal relationship verified.

@id.description: Unique relation identifier used as the predicate in fact assertions.

@domain.description: Subject type constraint. Empty or absent = wildcard (any subject type accepted). RelationRegistry.validate_usage() enforces this at fact parse time.

@range.description: Object type constraint. Empty or absent = wildcard (any object type accepted).

@transitive.description: Schema metadata only — does NOT execute graph closure or authorize inferred transitive facts. No runtime effect. Declaring transitive=true marks the relation semantics; graph closure is a separate, explicitly authorized operation.

@authority.description: Authority of this schema declaration, not of facts using this relation.

@description.description: Human-readable description of the relation's semantic meaning.
